s.n: Chargrilled crab claws with garlic butter
s.note: Gotta love crab. Blistered on the coals with lime.
s.how: Mash the butter with the garlic, chilli, coriander and the zest of one lime. Grill the claws over hot coals or a barbecue, turning, until smoky and hot through. Toss with the garlic butter until it melts, then serve with lime wedges.

s.note: Kingfish cured in lime and coconut milk. Chuck works out how to open coconuts.
s.how: Toss the fish with the lime juice and a good pinch of salt and chill for 10 minutes. Drain off half the lime juice and stir in the coconut milk, chilli, onion and cucumber. Scatter with coriander and serve in coconut shells or bowls with corn chips.

m.n: Spearfished whole snapper over the coals
m.note: Chuck learns to spear fish. Whole snapper stuffed with lemon and herbs.
m.how: Score each fish three times on both sides, rub with oil and salt, and stuff with lemon, dill and garlic. Wrap loosely in banana leaf or foil. Cook over medium coals or a hot barbecue, turning once, until the flesh flakes at the bone. Unwrap, squeeze over lime and serve straight from the leaf.

m.note: Slow pork ribs with a paprika crust. Chuck keeps the watch on Memphis time.
m.how: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic and onion powders, cayenne, thyme and 2 tsp salt, and rub all over the ribs. Wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C until tender. Unwrap, mop with the vinegar, dust with a little more rub and finish over hot coals or under the grill until crusty. Cut between the bones and serve.

w.n: Angel wings pavlova with mango and passionfruit
w.note: Crisp meringue piled with cream and mango. The one package Chuck never opens.
w.how: Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoonful at a time until thick and glossy. Fold in the cornflour and vinegar and shape into a round on a lined tray. Bake at 120C for 75 minutes, then cool in the oven with the door ajar. Whip the cream, pile it on and top with mango and passionfruit pulp.

d.n: Dr Pepper over two cups of ice
d.note: One Dr Pepper and two cups of ice. Chuck likes ice now.
d.how: Fill 8 cups with ice, two for each person. Pour the Dr Pepper over and add a lime wedge.
